config.description: Pure per-channel resolver. Latest field timestamp wins across applicable scopes, lexical record-key breaks ties. Effective period is supplied upstream. Keeps lamp ontology, intensity, legacy holds, Sara policy and power distinct. No state reads or external actions.
Pure manual adjustment around room/lamp Cosy=0 and Day=1 anchors. Preserves schedule anchors, bounds position to [-2,2], warms through 1950 K into RGB, and uses available upper brightness headroom.

Verified Innr RC250 on/off actions. One press toggles after a 400ms quiet interval; three or more presses reset room overrides once. Two presses do nothing. Single mode consumes the whole burst without intermediate power toggles. Area is looked up when dispatching.
Verified Innr RC250 brightness-step actions map to room up/down. Separate queued adapter remains responsive while the center gesture waits. Scene arrows await a verified hardware mapping.
